policy.sourceScope: CIS498 Computer Information Systems; proposed baseline for the other majors pending their departmental confirmation.
policy.interpretation: Owner-defined project workflow: company 50 + academic supervisor 50, followed by coordinator approval after all training requirements are met.
policy.hoursApproval: Company supervisor records dated hours; academic supervisor verifies or returns them. This digital approval sequence is a proposed implementation process, not a published university requirement.

opportunity-1.title: Software Development Intern
opportunity-1.description: Build accessible interfaces and test practical software features with a company supervisor.
opportunity-1.requirements: HTML, CSS, JavaScript and basic version control.

opportunity-2.title: Cybersecurity Intern
opportunity-2.description: Document network assets, investigate example security events and prepare reviewed incident summaries.
opportunity-2.requirements: Networking fundamentals, careful documentation and an interest in security.

opportunity-3.title: Data and AI Intern
opportunity-3.description: Prepare datasets, compare baseline models and communicate findings through supervised analytics work.
opportunity-3.requirements: Python fundamentals, basic statistics and clear written explanations.

opportunity-4.title: Digital Reality Intern
opportunity-4.description: Create interactive environments, prototype gameplay and document usability feedback.
opportunity-4.requirements: Basic 3D tooling or game-engine experience and a small portfolio.

opportunity-5.title: Business Systems Intern
opportunity-5.description: Map a business process, analyse requirements and prepare a working information-system prototype.
opportunity-5.requirements: Process modelling, spreadsheets and communication skills.

opportunity-6.title: Information Systems Intern
opportunity-6.description: Design accessible records screens, validate data-entry flows and prepare a training project report.
opportunity-6.requirements: Database concepts, wireframing and foundational web development.

opportunity-7.title: Frontend Interface Intern
opportunity-7.description: Improve responsive page layouts, test keyboard access and document interface decisions.
opportunity-7.requirements: Responsive HTML/CSS, JavaScript and attention to accessibility.

opportunity-8.title: Quality Assurance Intern
opportunity-8.description: Write test cases, reproduce interface defects and verify corrected training project features.
opportunity-8.requirements: Structured problem solving and clear bug reports.

opportunity-9.title: Game Design Intern
opportunity-9.description: Prototype a playable level and refine controls using structured playtest notes.
opportunity-9.requirements: Game design fundamentals and a playable portfolio prototype.

opportunity-10.title: Business Intelligence Intern
opportunity-10.description: Prepare reporting datasets and build an understandable operations dashboard from sample business records.
opportunity-10.requirements: Data cleaning, analytical reasoning and chart design.

opportunity-11.title: Network Operations Intern
opportunity-11.description: Document a supervised network lab and review operational logs with the technical team.
opportunity-11.requirements: Networking fundamentals and disciplined record keeping.

opportunity-12.title: Interactive Graphics Intern
opportunity-12.description: Develop lightweight interactive scenes and optimise graphics for laptop and phone screens.
opportunity-12.requirements: JavaScript or a game engine, graphics fundamentals and a portfolio.
